rev.t:
Beautiful place to have some GOOD coffee!
Just let them know how you like your coffee and enjoy the surprise :')
Tried the Basil Burst Cold Brew and it was very refreshing ☕
Visited Juno Coffee Club recently, and if you're someone who genuinely loves coffee or wants to explore what specialty coffee is all about, this is definitely a place to visit. …
Great coffee. The staff is friendly and helps you choose the best coffee for you. They have very creative options and know what they are talking about. Really enjoyed the experience!
